title: Deployment Gatekeeper: VPC API readiness & model exercise probes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight 'gatekeeper' probe suite that runs automatically after a VPC/private deployment to validate API readiness, model load/prefill, and basic smoke tests. The probe should be expressible as a Terraform module output so Private customers can opt into post-deploy verification. This ticket covers design, Terraform changes, probe runner service, basic load exercises, and wiring results to console dashboards and alerting.
acceptance_criteria: Probe deploys as part of the VPC after-deploy hook and exposes a stable results URL
API handshake and auth checks succeed for the configured customer identity (token or mTLS) within 30s
Model exercise: run a small sequence of synthetic prompts that exercise tokenizer, KV cache warmup, and generation path; expected p95 latency < 250ms for the smoke set under no external contention
Load exercise: controlled concurrency ramp to validate model can serve sustained 10-20 qps on dedicated pool (configurable); failures are recorded and annotated in the results
Terraform module exposes outputs: last_probe_status, last_probe_timestamp, probe_run_id, probe_artifact_url
Probe writes structured results to Console (per-deployment dashboard) and triggers an alert when health checks fail per the SLO policy
technical_notes: Design decision: implement probe as a short-lived container task run by the deploy orchestrator versus a permanent daemon. Short-lived minimizes attack surface and cost; downside is slightly longer total time-to-ready.
KV cache warmup: use synthetic prompts that mirror production token-length distribution. Avoid replaying customer text to prevent data leak; we will sample token-length buckets instead.

Model fallback strategy: when load exercise shows memory pressure, the gatekeeper will attempt a graceful test against a smaller compatible variant and record differences in latency and output hashes.
Trade-off: synchronous end-to-end checks increase deploy duration. We'll make the full load exercise optional (flagged by terraform variable) and run lightweight API + model-exercise by default.
Security: probe credentials must use short-lived tokens; integrate with customer KMS/HSM rotation where available. Security review required for probe artifact storage and logs.
progress_updates: 2026-02-20: RFC drafted detailing probe phases (1: API handshake, 2: model exercise, 3: optional load ramp). Linked design doc.
2026-02-25: Prototype probe-runner implemented as a container in a feature branch: github.com/redwood-inference/probes/pull/142. Basic /health and single-prompt flow validated in internal sandbox.
2026-03-02: Terraform module changes landed in feature branch (terraform-modules/vpc-post-probe). Exposed outputs for probe_run_id and last_probe_status. Needs infra review.

2026-03-05: First integrated run against staging VPC failed due to token binding issue (401) — root cause: deploy orchestration not injecting vault-refresh hook. Raised ENG-99201 to add vault-refresh step.

2026-03-08: Retest after vault-refresh fix: API handshake succeeded. Model exercise ran but p95 latency for smoke prompts was 320ms (target <250ms). Observed cold KV cache misses; adjusting warmup sequence to hit more prefix buckets.

2026-03-10: Updated warmup sequence and added lightweight parallelism; re-run shows p95 210ms for the smoke set. Pushed PR for terraform module and probe-runner: github.com/redwood-inference/probes/pull/158. Requesting infra and security reviews.
review_feedback: Lina Chen (Infra): prefer the probe to emit structured metrics (prometheus labels) instead of opaque logs so Console can automatically consume and chart them.
Jonas Meier (Security): ensure probe artifacts stored in S3 use encryption with customer-managed keys when available; redact any generated tokens in saved logs.
Priya Nair (Product): make the full load exercise opt-in; default should be the quick smoke + model exercise so self-serve customers don't see long deploy times.
next_steps: Address Infra and Security feedback (emit metrics, KMS integration) - owner: Marco Ruiz
Merge terraform module PR and add test matrix covering opt-in load exercise - owner: Infra
Add automated Console alert mapping for probe failures and include run artifacts link in deploy activity - owner: Console team
Schedule canary on a small set of customers for one week before flipping default opt-in for full load exercise
